sentiment.rationale: The company reported Q1 sales and EPS in line with expectations, and full-year guidance was reaffirmed unchanged. Management noted ongoing pressure from DIY big-ticket discretionary demand and a cautious consumer, with no inflection expected in 2025. The forward outlook is flat, with no guidance raise or material positive surprise, resulting in a neutral score.

summary.revenue: Q1 sales of $20.9 billion, comparable sales down 1.7% (in line with expectations).
summary.eps: Diluted EPS of $2.92, in line with expectations.
summary.guidance: Affirmed fiscal 2025 outlook: sales $83.5B-$84.5B, comp sales flat to up 1%, operating margin 12.3%-12.4%, diluted EPS ~$12.15-$12.40. Q2 comp sales expected ~150 bps above bottom end of full-year guide.
summary.margin: Gross margin 33.4%, up 19 bps YoY. Operating margin 11.9%, down 50 bps YoY. Full-year gross margin expected roughly flat.
key_risks: Ongoing pressure in DIY bigger ticket discretionary demand
Slower start to spring due to unfavorable weather
Elevated mortgage rates and affordability challenges
Uncertain macro environment and cautious consumer
Tariff impacts expected to be more concentrated in second half of the year
key_opportunities: Mid-single-digit Pro sales growth in Q1
Online sales up 6% driven by traffic and conversion
Acquisition of Artisan Design Group to expand Pro penetration in new home construction
Launch of product marketplace with Mirakl to scale extended aisle
Mylow AI-powered virtual advisor and Mylow Companion for associates
Strong spring in-stock positions and customer satisfaction scores up 100 bps

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: Management expressed confidence in execution and strategic initiatives ('we remain confident in our team's ability to execute at a high level') but also acknowledged ongoing headwinds ('bigger ticket project spend remains under pressure') and reaffirmed rather than raised guidance.

evidence.claim: Diluted EPS of $2.92, in line with expectations.

today we are affirming our fiscal 2025 outlook. We continue to expect sales ranging from $83.5 billion to $84.5 billion with comparable sales in a range of flat to up 1%. We expect operating margin in a range of 12.3% to 12.4% and full year diluted earnings per share of approximately $12.15 to $12.40.
